# Jens Tofte

Jens Tofte is a leading senior consultant physician (Ledende overlæge) at Odense Universitetshospital – Svendborg, who represents the Danish Psychiatric Society (Dansk Psykiatrisk Selskab) in the steering group of the ADHD database (ADHD-databasen) [^src1]. He appears in the corpus as one of the named members of this steering group, whose broader mandate covers representatives from all five Danish regions, professional societies, patient organizations, and the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) [^src1]. The steering group's work, as documented alongside Tofte's listing, relates to the ADHD database's population data for the period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025, including figures on ADHD assessment and treatment pathways for children, adolescents, and adults, as well as regional variation in the use of the pathway marker for refuted suspicions of ADHD [^src1].

Beyond his listed role and institutional affiliation, no further biographical or professional details about Jens Tofte are given in the available material.
